list.title: Connections
list.empty: No connections yet. Use + at the top right to add an SSH server or a database.
list.selectHint: Manage the servers and databases agents can use in their work here. By default, no agent has access.

editor.deleteConfirm: Delete it? Agent permissions are deleted too.

definition.title: Definition
definition.hint: Agents use this to understand what the connection is useful for; the password is never shown to an agent.
definition.name: Connection name
definition.productionWarning: Production: every operation that changes data or is destructive (SQL writes/DDL, SSH commands outside the read list) waits for your approval before it runs.
definition.descriptionPlaceholderDb: e.g. The company's ERP database. Contains stock, order, customer and production data.
definition.descriptionPlaceholderSsh: e.g. The server the ERP application runs on.
definition.purposePlaceholder: What should agents use it for?
definition.notesPlaceholderDb: e.g. stock, order, customer tables; daily ETL at 02:00

auth.title: Authentication
auth.hint: Passwords and keys are encrypted with the operating system's secure storage (safeStorage); they are never sent to the UI, agents, terminals or logs.
auth.readOnlyHint: Every SELECT an agent runs connects as this user, so the database itself enforces the no-write rule. Without it, agents cannot read from this connection. Create a user that only has SELECT privileges in the database and enter it here.
auth.agentHint: Uses the OpenSSH Authentication Agent on Windows and SSH_AUTH_SOCK elsewhere.
auth.hostKeyReset: Host key reset; it will be pinned again on the next connection

commands.title: Allowed commands
commands.hint: One pattern per line; * means any arguments. The agent's level decides which lists it can use; an admin can run any command. Commands containing ; && > < ` $( ) are admin-only, and every command joined with | must be on a list.

access.intro: The default policy is no access: an agent only sees and uses the connections you grant here. Changes apply from the next tool call.

schema.hint: Agents read the schema with the db_schema tool (over the read-only connection); you can explore and check it here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every connection access and critical operation: which agent, when, in which task, what it did and the result.
